entries.name: DARK SOULS™: REMASTERED Weapon DPS Script
entries.tooltip:
A Tampermonkey script that adds a “DPS R1” column to the Dark Souls weapon table on soulsplanner.com/darksouls/weaponatk.
It uses per-weapon R1 attack speed (APS) with boss/enemy resistance calculator (Regular / Strike / Slash / Thrust + Magic / Fire / Lightning).
The guide explains the exact formulas used for damage after defense, Bleed damage over time, Black Knight vs Chaos Demon bonus, and Occult vs Occult-weak bonus.
Under its assumptions (pure R1 spam, no downtime), you can sort by DPS and see the mathematically optimal weapon for any given boss or custom enemy setup.

entries.name: Crash Debug
entries.tooltip:
Writes a log of what every mod is doing, so after a crash you can see which one ran last.

- Save to: Desktop, Documents or the mods folder
- File type: .log or .txt
- Shows you the full path of the log file
- Follow Other Mods: log which mod is running, or only area changes
- Lines Kept: how many lines before the log starts over

entries.name: Gear Score
entries.tooltip:
Puts a score on every weapon and shield, so you can compare gear at a glance. Shows on item cards in your backpack, vending machines, mission rewards and loot on the ground. Page Up / Page Down in the backpack lists everything you carry, best first.

Weapon score (DPS):
shots x damage x pellets / (shots x fire interval + reload)
shots = magazine size / ammo used per shot

Shield score (Shield Power):
capacity + recharge rate x (60 - recharge delay)

Values are read straight off the item, unrounded, so they can differ slightly from the card. Character skills are not counted.

- Disregard Accuracy: on = every bullet hits. Off = DPS scaled by the gun's accuracy
- Disregard Critical: on = ignore crits. Off = DPS multiplied by the gun's crit bonus, as if every shot crits
- Disregard Elements: on = ignore burn, shock and corrosion. Off = adds elemental damage, scaled by the x1 to x4 rating
- Score font size: how big the score prints on the card

entries.name: Hide Full Pickups
entries.tooltip: Hides ammo pickups you have no room for. Anything that would say FULL loses its beam and icon, and comes back once you spend some ammo.

entries.name: Infinite Ammo
entries.tooltip:
Infinite ammo. Firing never uses any up.

- No Reload: also stops the magazine emptying, so you never reload

entries.name: Infinite Health
entries.tooltip: Infinite health. You cannot die.

entries.name: Jump Higher
entries.tooltip:
Higher jumps than the game normally allows.

- Jump Height: how high you jump. Game default is 630
- Optional: debug setting to see jump height values

entries.name: Loot Radar
entries.tooltip:
Puts loot and unopened chests on your compass, with the distance to each one. Ammo you have no room for is left out.

Colours: green = weapons and items, yellow = money, blue = ammo and health, red = red chest, white = white chest

- Toggle each type on or off: weapons, money, ammo, red chests, white chests
- Display Only Better Weapons: hides gear worse than the weakest of that type you already carry, and blocks picking it up. Uses the same scores as Gear Score: DPS for weapons, Shield Power for shields
- Hide Full Pickups: hides ammo you have no room for
- Show Distance: distance above each mark
- Units: metres or feet

entries.name: Mission Progress
entries.tooltip:
Tracks your mission progress and total game completion, following the Borderlands mission order.

Colours: blue = game completion, yellow = the mission you are tracking, red = missions you skipped past, grey = what comes next

- Enable DLC Missions: 216 missions instead of 126
- Flag Skipped Missions: the red list on or off
- Achievement Warnings: warns when a known bug in your current mission can cost you an achievement
- Upcoming missions shown: how many missions to list ahead

entries.name: Movement Speed Changer
entries.tooltip:
Set your own speed for walking, running, aiming, crouching and driving. Each slider shows the game default next to it.

- Walking, Running, Aiming, Crouching: speed on foot
- Driving: top speed of any vehicle
- Optional: debug setting to see speed values

entries.name: No Backpack Limit
entries.tooltip:
Set your own backpack size.

- Backpack slots: how many slots you get

entries.name: No Recoil
entries.tooltip:
No recoil on any weapon.

- Also Stop Spread: every shot lands dead centre instead of scattering

entries.name: No Reload
entries.tooltip: Infinite magazine. It never empties, so you never reload.

entries.name: No Skill Cooldown
entries.tooltip: No cooldown on your action skill. It is ready every time you press the key. Pressing it while the skill is active restarts it.

entries.name: Objective Distance
entries.tooltip:
Shows the distance to your current objective, plus a line on the ground pointing the way. The line follows the paths the game's own characters walk.

- Show Distance: the reading on or off
- Show Route Line: the line on or off
- Units: metres or feet
- Position: under the compass or top of screen
- Route Colour: green, blue, red, yellow or orange

entries.name: Repeat Mission
entries.tooltip:
Replay any mission you have already finished.

- Mission: pick one from your log
- Repeat Selected Mission: puts it back in your log to do again
- Ready to Turn In: sets it straight to ready to hand in
- Mark Complete: marks it finished
- Refresh the List: reload what is in your log

entries.name: Reset Chests
entries.tooltip:
Closes every chest you have already opened in the area you are in, so you can loot them again.

- Reset Chests in This Area: press to close the chests around you
- Reset Red Chests / Reset White Chests: which types are included

entries.name: Run And Walk
entries.tooltip:
Adds a hold key and a toggle key for running, instead of the game's default. Shift to hold, Caps Lock to toggle. Both bindings can be changed.

- Camera Effect: the view widens while running. Turn off to leave the camera alone
- Optional: debug setting to see speed values

entries.name: Sell Value
entries.tooltip:
Shows what an item sells for, right on its card.

- Sell value font size: how big the line prints

entries.name: Teleport
entries.tooltip:
Fast travel to anywhere you have already visited in this playthrough.

- Place: pick where to go
- Go There: press to travel
- Refresh the List: reload where you have been

entries.name: Use No Reload
entries.tooltip: Stops the Use key (E) from reloading your gun. In the stock game, pressing Use with nothing in front of you triggers a reload. Reloading is left to the reload key only.

entries.name: Vehicle Loot
entries.tooltip:
Picks up loot automatically while you drive, so you never have to get out.

- Reach in metres: how close loot has to be
- Loot Weapons / Loot Money / Loot Ammo: which types get picked up
